purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 792 Santiago de los Caballeros (city code 779); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
registryBasis: The Dominican Republic’s official Registro Inmobiliario identifies its Dirección Regional de Mensuras Catastrales Norte as headquartered in Santiago de los Caballeros and gives it jurisdiction over Santiago Province. This is city-specific institutional evidence for the ranked settlement. The same agency publishes a public national parcel-viewer, but its page requires a security-verification step and the advertised downloads/table do not establish a safe geometry-and-ID-only response contract.

officialSources.observation: Official Registro Inmobiliario directory identifies the North Regional Cadastral Survey Directorate, headquartered in Santiago de los Caballeros, with jurisdiction over Santiago Province.

Anonymous public page offers coordinate/positional input, parcel-status checkboxes and KML/Excel downloads, then displays a security-verification step before consultation. No query was submitted; the page alone does not establish a safe response-field allowlist.
Official instructions describe map click or coordinate/positional search, parcel layers and export buttons. They do not specify a geometry-only schema.

searchQueries.result: La Dirección Regional de Mensuras Catastrales Norte tiene sede en Santiago de los Caballeros y jurisdicción sobre Santiago. La consulta parcelaria admite coordenadas/designación posicional y ofrece KML/Excel, pero exige verificación de seguridad y no expone un esquema que garantice solo geometría e identificadores; no se envió consulta.
